name: Rock Paper Scissors
summary:
Play rock paper scissors with a simple neural network. RPS recognizes your hand gestures. RPS recognizes which hand you are using and adapts accordingly. Play 2 out of 3 to win. Press the star button to record your own gestures!

Create your own hand gestures. Touch your knuckles together to enable record mode. In record mode, you can record 3 different gestures.
The intro gesture (hand heart) was created this way.  These  gestures are saved as CSV text files.
